units.rawText: Hatsuchiri and me? Why are you asking about that? Playing the nice, approachable teacher helping a problem child? There are so many agents in the Oasis, if you have time to do this with every single one of us, you must be pretty idle indeed.

units.rawText: You still insist on knowing? How tenacious of you. There's nothing interesting between her and me. You'll just get bored if I tell you everything.
